visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A girl in a white t-shirt and black leggings kicks a soccer ball directly towards the camera on a paved outdoor path. The background features a multi-story building and trees with pinkish foliage under natural daylight. (2) Sharp cut to a man with a shaved head and a small topknot sitting in a red-and-black gaming chair. He is wearing a black t-shirt with a pink flower graphic and holding a blue game controller, looking toward the camera and laughing. The setting is a brightly lit indoor room with a wooden door and shelves. (3) The man leans back dramatically as the frame shifts to a product close-up of a blue supplement box titled '南極磷蝦油'. (4) A montage follows showing various informational graphics about Omega-3, phospholipids, and absorption rates, interspersed with shots of the man in a white t-shirt opening the bottle, pouring out dark red gel capsules, and swallowing them with water from a white mug. (5) The man introduces a second silver container for '晶亮水潤配方'. He displays the dark red capsules in his hand and points to the camera. (6) The video concludes with the man holding both products near his face while five certification logos and a yellow discount code overlay appear on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male vocal starts with an energetic rhetorical question over a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic BGM. A subtle impact SFX aligns with the soccer ball kick. (2) Vocal tone shifts to friendly and laughing. Frequent 'ping' and 'pop' SFX accompany the appearance of text subtitles and logo animations. (3) BGM swells slightly as the man introduces the product. A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during the move to the close-up shot. (4) Rapid speech listing benefits is punctuated by rhythmic 'ding' sounds for each bullet point. Ambient sounds of liquid pouring and capsule swallowing are clearly audible. (5) Final phase features a high-pitched enthusiastic CTA with a loud 'Cartoon' style SFX. BGM continues until a clean hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and sell '健康工程師' (Health Engineer) Krill Oil and Lutein supplements using a high-energy, relatable vlog style that addresses common health issues like fatigue and work pressure.
